responsibility: Defines the method-lookup interface and shared result types for this module, including the resolved `MethodCallee`, lookup error categories, and diagnostic-facing helpers. It coordinates probing, confirmation, UFCS resolution, trait-import tracking, and provider registration so `FnCtxt` can resolve methods and associated value items from types and traits.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the `generator_interior/*/mod.rs` files, this `mod.rs` is not about generator liveness or suspension analysis; it handles method and associated-item lookup. Unlike `fn_ctxt/mod.rs`, it does not define the main per-body type-checking context, but instead builds on `FnCtxt` to provide probing, confirmation, UFCS resolution, and method-specific result/error types.
